answer: Exclusive escrow stops one bond from backing many identities. Each account's stake enters through a single inlet contract that marks those coins as pledged to that account until the epoch closes, and the lock is a falcon signature over coin and account. Running 1,000 fakes at 50 POA therefore ties up 50,000 POA, not 50. Any coin appearing in two locks is a provable double pledge: both stakes burn, and the proof fits in one thread of the audit log. Colluders cannot share the cost, because a coin sits in only one lock at a time. Honest agents lock once and get it back.
